title: UFO files: the photos and videos in latest Pentagon release
Pentagon releases fresh tranche of UFO files
description: Among the clips is footage filmed over the Gulf of Oman in 2021, appearing to show a dark orb moving in irregular patterns through the sky

title: Pentagon releases new UFO files: Reports describe 500-foot triangle, mysterious lights and alleged metal sphere with ‘human body’
description: The Pentagon has unveiled new declassified files detailing unexplained aerial phenomena. These documents include pilot accounts of silent triangular objects and mysterious lights. One report describes a decades-old incident involving a metal sphere and a body. The government aims for greater transparency regarding these anomalous sightings. These released records preserve eyewitness testimony and investigative materials.

title: Pentagon releases new batch of 41 UFO files, including videos and images
description: This is the fifth disclosure after President Donald Trump signed an executive order in January this year directing the military and other agencies to produce more documents related to UFOs or unidentified anomalous phenomena or UAP.

title: Pentagon releases new batch of UFO files: "Did you see that?"
description: The Pentagon on Friday released a new batch of documents and images related to UFOs, the fifth disclosure in recent months about the strange encounters.
